# Timber Creek Retrievers

> > Professional dog training, breeding, and boarding services specializing in Labrador Retrievers across Tennessee and Mississippi since the mid-1990s.

Timber Creek Retrievers, founded by George and Kristian Henry, provides comprehensive dog training programs including retriever training, obedience training, and AKC-registered puppy breeding. The company operates multiple facilities across the Southeast and serves clients throughout Tennessee, Mississippi, Georgia, and surrounding regions.

- [Retriever Training in TN and MS to Mold Your Dog Into a Skillful Hunter](https://timbercreekretrievers.com/retriever-training): Retriever training services in Tennessee and Mississippi for hunting dogs
